title: Drink n' Drive
tips: Remember: Using the gas makes you faster than using the brakes

title: Drink n' Guess
tips: Try to answer the right question

title: Drink n' Draw
tips: If you draw better than the other players, that is good!
The better you draw, the more points you get!

title: Drink n' React
tips: React as fast as you can when the game starts
The faster you react, the more points you get!

title: Drink n' Maze
tips: Switch to phone mode if playing on a smartphone
Tilt your phone to move the ball
The faster you reach the finish, the more points you get!
